Overview

Kuala Terengganu is a city in Terengganu with a population of 375,000. The capital of Terengganu, a coastal city known for its beautiful mosques, batik industry, and as a gateway to the Perhentian Islands. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
